fact: Car 23 allegedly failed to slow for a single yellow flag
offence: Alleged breach of Article B1.8.4 a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data and in-car video evidence. At no point any yellow flag was displayed to Car 23. However, when seeing a green flag in front of him, the driver of Car 23 reacted by lifting the throttle into Turn 1. The Stewards determine that no infringement was evident and take no further action.
stewards: determine that no infringement was evident
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 23 Alleged Yellow Flag Infringement
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams F1 Team
